newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman raises Q1 airline views.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman raises Q1 airline views.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said analyst Brian Harris raised first quarter 1997 estimates on several airlines, citing the current strong industry revenue environment.
-- Raised America West Holdings Corp first quarter view to $0.30 from 0.25.
-- Raised AMR Corp Q1 view to $1.50 from $1.00.
-- Raised Delta Air Lines Inc Q1 estimate to $2.30 from $1.65.
-- Raised Southwest Airlines Co Q1 estimate to $0.20 from $0.18.
-- Raised US Airways Group Inc Q1 estimate to $0.75 per share from $0.30.
-- Said earlier this month had raised estimates on UAL Corp and Continental Airlines Inc.
-- "This quarter is ripe with earnings surprise possibilities, with Continental, Delta, US Airways and UAL representing our prime candidates," Harris said in a report.
-- Said lowered Q1 estimate on Northwest Airlines Corp to $0.45 per share from $0.50.
-- Lowered Q1 view on Reno Air Inc to a loss of $0.45 from loss of $0.30.
-- Lowered Q1 view on ValuJet Inc to a loss of $0.40 from a loss of $0.30.
